subject: CAIQ dataflow provenance walkthrough - sample exchange for ZeldaHealth audit
messages:
From: Sandra Li <sandra.li@zeldahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@zeldahealth.com
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: dataflow provenance + sample evidence ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our audit team at ZeldaHealth has a CAIQ window next month and they asked for a focused evidence package covering dataflow provenance and tenant separation proofs for inference workloads. Specifically they're asking for: a) a mapping of CAIQ control IDs to our dataflow diagrams and ownership, b) a small set of runtime log samples that show request routing and tenant IDs redacted, and c) a short narrative describing how KV cache and prefix caching are isolated across tenants.

Can Redwood provide a walkthrough and an exchange mechanism for the artifacts (we prefer a timeboxed secure upload)? We need to ingest the evidence into our portal by 2026-06-02.

Best,
Sandra Li
Senior Compliance Manager
ZeldaHealth
[Attachment: zelda-caiq-ask.pdf (pdf)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sandra Li <sandra.li@zeldahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: dataflow provenance + sample evidence ask

Hi Sandra —

Thanks for the clear list. We can run a 45-minute walkthrough and deliver a scoped evidentiary bundle (mapping spreadsheet, diagram, and redacted log samples) ahead of your ingest deadline. Proposed plan:

- Wed 2026-05-19 10:00-10:45 PT: live walkthrough (team: myself + Kim + Jonas)
- Deliverables by Fri 2026-05-21 EOD: mapping spreadsheet (CSV + Excel), dataflow diagram PDF, and a tarball of redacted runtime logs (samples).
- Transfer mechanism: secure upload link + shared Drive folder; if you prefer SFTP/DocuSign transfer instructions we can accommodate.

Two quick clarifying questions before the walkthrough:
1) Which CAIQ control families should we prioritize? (e.g., ID & Access, Logging and Monitoring, Multi-tenancy)
2) Do you require raw request IDs or just session-level traces?

I'll invite Kim and Jonas to scope the mapping.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-walkthrough-agenda.docx (docx)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: dataflow provenance + sample evidence ask

Sandra / Marissa —

Quick note on prioritization: for a provenance-focused CAIQ pack I recommend we prioritize the following control families: LOG-01 (Logging & Monitoring), ID-01/ID-02 (Identity & Access), DT-02 (Dataflow & Classification), and TEN-01 (Tenant Separation / Isolation). I've attached a working tabbed spreadsheet that crosswalks these controls to our internal artifacts and owners.

I'll own the mapping tab for DT-02 and TEN-01. Marcus (cc'd on the email thread but not included above) will pull the runtime log samples and redact tenant identifiers.

Deliverables we'll attach to the Drive folder: redwood-caiq-dataflow-provenance-map.xlsx, dataflow-diagram.pdf, sample-runtime-logs-202604.tgz (redacted).

Kim
Principal Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-caiq-dataflow-provenance-map.xlsx (xlsx)]
